name: GitHub
summary: Connect GitHub to follow issues and pull requests on a native board, and let the agent read, comment, review, open and merge as your connected account.

commands.title: List GitHub Repositories
commands.description: List one page of the repositories the connected GitHub account can access, most recently updated first.

commands.title: List GitHub Issues
commands.description: List one page of an owner/name repository's issues, without pull requests. Each row is a summary; read an issue to get its body and comments.

commands.title: List GitHub Pull Requests
commands.description: List one page of an owner/name repository's pull requests. Each row is a summary; read a pull request to get its body, reviews, files and checks.

commands.title: Read GitHub Issue
commands.description: Read an issue: its title, body, labels, assignees and state, with its comments. `more` names any list GitHub has further pages of.

commands.title: Read GitHub Pull Request
commands.description: Read a pull request: its title, body, branches, head commit and merge state, with its comments, reviews, review comments, changed files (without patches), checks and commit statuses. `more` names any list GitHub has further pages of.

commands.title: Read GitHub Pull Request Diff
commands.description: Read the changes of a pull request as a unified diff. A very long diff is cut short and says so.

commands.title: Read From GitHub
commands.description: Read anything else from GitHub's REST API with a GET request, such as /user for the connected account, /repos/owner/name/actions/runs, /repos/owner/name/releases, or /search/issues?q=... . Use per_page and page in the path to ask for less at a time.
commands.inputSchemaJSON: {"type":"object","properties":{"path":{"type":"string","description":"A REST API path with its query, starting with /."}},"required":["path"]}

commands.title: Comment On GitHub
commands.description: Post a comment on an issue or a pull request. Acts as the GitHub account the user connected in the GitHub panel.
commands.inputSchemaJSON: {"type":"object","properties":{"repository":{"type":"string","description":"The repository as owner/name."},"number":{"type":"integer","minimum":1,"description":"The issue or pull request number."},"body":{"type":"string","description":"The comment, in Markdown."}},"required":["repository","number","body"]}

commands.title: Create GitHub Issue
commands.description: Open a new issue in a repository. Acts as the GitHub account the user connected in the GitHub panel.

commands.title: Update GitHub Issue
commands.description: Change an issue's or a pull request's title, body, labels or assignees, or close or reopen it. Labels and assignees replace the ones it has. Acts as the GitHub account the user connected in the GitHub panel.
commands.inputSchemaJSON: {"type":"object","properties":{"repository":{"type":"string","description":"The repository as owner/name."},"number":{"type":"integer","minimum":1,"description":"The issue or pull request number."},"title":{"type":"string"},"body":{"type":"string"},"state":{"enum":["open","closed"]},"state_reason":{"enum":["completed","not_planned","reopened"]},"labels":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"string"},"description":"Label names, replacing the current ones."},"assignees":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"string"},"description":"Account logins, replacing the current ones."}},"required":["repository","number"]}

commands.title: Create GitHub Pull Request
commands.description: Open a pull request from a branch that is already pushed to GitHub. Acts as the GitHub account the user connected in the GitHub panel.
commands.inputSchemaJSON: {"type":"object","properties":{"repository":{"type":"string","description":"The repository as owner/name."},"title":{"type":"string"},"head":{"type":"string","description":"The branch with the changes, or owner:branch from a fork."},"base":{"type":"string","description":"The branch to merge into."},"body":{"type":"string","description":"The description, in Markdown."},"draft":{"type":"boolean"}},"required":["repository","title","head","base"]}

commands.title: Review GitHub Pull Request
commands.description: Submit a review on a pull request: approve it, request changes, or comment. Anything but an approval needs a body. Acts as the GitHub account the user connected in the GitHub panel.
commands.inputSchemaJSON: {"type":"object","properties":{"repository":{"type":"string","description":"The repository as owner/name."},"number":{"type":"integer","minimum":1,"description":"The pull request number."},"event":{"enum":["approve","request_changes","comment"]},"body":{"type":"string","description":"The review, in Markdown."}},"required":["repository","number","event"]}

commands.title: Merge GitHub Pull Request
commands.description: Merge a pull request. `sha` is the head commit read from the pull request; GitHub refuses the merge if the pull request has moved since. Acts as the GitHub account the user connected in the GitHub panel.
commands.inputSchemaJSON: {"type":"object","properties":{"repository":{"type":"string","description":"The repository as owner/name."},"number":{"type":"integer","minimum":1,"description":"The pull request number."},"method":{"enum":["merge","squash","rebase"]},"sha":{"type":"string","description":"The pull request's full head commit SHA."}},"required":["repository","number","method","sha"]}
